title: Chapter 413 - 413 A Waste Of Talent; Phone Call!

Chapter 413 - 413 A Waste Of Talent; Phone Call!

Chapter 413 - 413 A Waste of Talent; Phone Call!

413 A Waste of Talent; Phone Call!

Jingbei, Institute of Science and Technology.

Under the protection of the academicians, the super battery that looked like a computer was brought to the laboratory intact.

Then, the academicians could not wait to use many complicated instruments to test it.

Not long after, there was a wave of enthusiastic praise.

“Unbelievable! It’s unbelievable! It actually has so much electricity!”

“Although I’ve read the thesis, seeing the real thing still makes me feel like it’s beyond my imagination!”

At this moment, an old academician with white hair said to Zhao Xueqin and Li Rongfa, “Professor Zhao, Professor Li, can you explain the research process and specific principles of the super battery?”

When everyone heard this, they all cast expectant gazes.

In their eyes…

Zhao Xueqin and Li Rongfa were the second authors of the thesis. They must have participated in the specific project. Other than Lin Fan, they were the only people in the world who had the most in-depth research on super batteries.

Zhao Xueqin and Li Rongfa blushed when they saw the famous academicians staring at them.

“Actually, we don’t know much about the super battery.

“We didn’t participate in the research of the super battery. The reason why our names are listed as the second authors is probably because Lin Fan wanted to take care of us.”

After the two of them finished speaking, they wished they could find a hole to hide in.

In a sense, this was academic fraud.

The academicians did not pay much attention to this matter. They only looked a little regretful.

“It’s a waste of talent for a genius like Lin Fan to be a student at Jiangbei University,” the old academician sighed.

“Director Feng, can’t we let him come to the Institute of Science? If he wants to stay in Jiangbei, we can move the entire Institute of Science there!”

For the sake of one person, they would move the entire Institute of Science!

How sincere was this?

Feng Zhixiang pondered and said, “This… I’ll find a chance to get Lin Fan’s opinion. In my opinion, we can first establish a research institute or a branch in Jiangbei. Even if Lin Fan doesn’t come, everyone will have a chance to interact with him.”

The old academician said happily, “Director Feng, you finally have a good suggestion!”

“Are you saying that I didn’t have a good suggestion before?” Feng Zhixiang glared at him.

“I didn’t say that, haha!” the old academician said with a smile.

…

Lin Fan did not know anything about what was happening at the Institute of Science.

At this moment, he was lying on the soft sofa and yawning out of boredom.

After a while, his attention fell on the 553 red packets displayed on the screen.

They were from the money he spent during his one-month stay in Hong Kong.

Lin Fan muttered, “I only spent five million in a month…”

One had to know…

Lin Fan’s daily income was close to 20 million, and this did not include the dividends and his rental yield.

Five million a month was indeed too little.

“Let’s see what I can get first.”

[Do you wish to open the 553 red packets?]

“Yes!”

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received three yuan.]

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received 1,999 yuan.]

…

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve obtained 51% of Lianjia Real Estate’s shares!]

…

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve obtained one Rolls-Royce Phantom.]

…

“Ding! Congratulations, you’ve obtained a one yuan critical hit card.]

…

From the 553 red packets, he got a total of 132,991 yuan.

He also got a Rolls-Royce Phantom that cost about ten million yuan.

There was also the one yuan critical hit card that would allow him to earn 100 million yuan if he spent one yuan.

Lin Fan did not care about these.

He immediately placed his attention on the 51% shares of Lianjia Real Estate.

Lianjia Real Estate was the largest real estate company in Hua Nation, with a market value of about 100 billion.

51% of the shares was about 50 billion yuan.

Lin Fan touched his nose and smiled. “Han Tian works at Lianjian. If she knows that I’ve become the major shareholder, I wonder what her expression would be like?”

At this moment, Lin Fan’s phone rang.

He looked at the caller ID and saw that it was his sister, Lin Xiaoyao.

“Brother!” As soon as the call connected, Lin Xiaoyao’s voice rang out.

“Your brother is not deaf.” Lin Fan rubbed his ears.

“Did you invent that car battery?” Lin Xiaoyao asked excitedly.

“Yup,” Lin Fan said.

“Then, did you get 35% of Yadi’s shares?” Lin Xiaoyao asked again.

“Yes,” Lin Fan said.

“F*ck!” Lin Xiaoyao shouted.

Lin Fan rubbed his ears and said, “Xiaoyao, don’t be so shocked.”

However, he could only hear a burst of laughter over the phone.

Obviously, Lin Xiaoyao did not hear him.

Lin Fan could not help but shake his head and slowly press the end call button.

Just as he hung up, Lin Fan’s phone rang again.

Initially, Lin Fan thought that Lin Xiaoyao had called him back. However, when he looked closely…

He realized that it was an unfamiliar number from An City.

Lin Fan did not hesitate and answered the call.

“Hello, is this Mr. Lin?”

A slightly respectful voice sounded from the phone.

Lin Fan said, “It’s me. Who are you?”

After hearing Lin Fan’s reply, the voice on the phone became even more respectful and excited.

“Hello, Mr. Lin. I’m the chairman of Lianjia Real Estate, Zhang Weimin.”

Compared to the chairmen of Yadi Automobile, Yinshan Group, Penguin Group, and Little Tanuki Group, who felt helpless when they found out that a large number of their companies’ shares had been bought by others…

Zhang Weimin was even more open-minded.

This was because the entire real estate industry had been in a slump recently.

Lianjia was also on the verge of incurring losses.

Now that someone had bought the company’s shares, it meant that the person had confidence in his company!

That person was saving Lianjia!

It was a good thing!

Lin Fan said, “So, it’s Chairman Zhang. Hello.”

“Please don’t call me Chairman Zhang,” Zhang Weimin hurriedly said. “You can just call me Lil Zhang.”

Lin Fan had received similar requests many times before.

Therefore, he did not find it too strange and said, “I’ll just call you by your name, Weimin.”

“Alright, Mr. Lin. You can call me whatever you want,” Zhang Weimin said.

“Mr. Lin, you seem to be in Jiangbei?”

“Yes,” Lin Fan replied.

“That’s great. Not long ago, Lianjia built a central headquarters in Jiangbei. I wonder if you have time to give some guidance? In addition, you can decide the future development direction of Lianjia,” Zhang Weimin said.

The central headquarters?

Decide on the future development of Lianjia?

Lin Fan had never been interested in such things and was prepared to reject him.

However, he thought of something and said, “Alright!”
